passages: At dawn, Nera slipped through the flooded arch beneath North Bridge. She hid the brass gate key inside a blue ceramic jar beside the baker’s oven and left before the market bell. The person waiting on the opposite bank was the ferryman, not the watchman.

Milo repaired clocks for the stationmaster. A scorched timetable fell from the ledger where the clerk had written the date of the last freight departure. The margin named a platform, but the destination had been deliberately erased.
The retired judge promised to guard the witness until her hearing. She carried a plain leather satchel filled with legal notes and refused entry to the inspector who brought a red envelope.
Alma escondió una moneda de plata debajo de la piedra del molino. Antes del amanecer regresó con su hermana; las dos reconocieron el ruido de las aspas, pero no consiguieron mover la piedra.
Ilyan réparait la lunette dans la tour. La lentille était fendue, alors il rangea son carnet près du télescope. Son apprenti ramassa les outils pendant que la pluie couvrait les vitres.
Pavel received a letter written by his aunt, who urged him to travel before the bridge closed. He tucked it into a tin box and asked the railway clerk to hold a seat without recording his name.
The library keeper left a copper lamp burning on the upper floor until the caretaker arrived. The keeper set a silver seal on the desk next to a box of blank cards and locked the register away.
The miller’s apprentice borrowed a wooden ladder to reach the shutters. A stranger offered a gold coin to unlock the mill, but the apprentice returned the coin and shut the door.
Sera brought a white coat to the clinic after the laundry closed. A nurse wrote a note about the missing ledger. Nobody found the gloves that were supposed to be in the bottom drawer.

bible.name: Mira
bible.description: Nera’s cousin and a traveling tailor. She has a blue wool coat and a limp in her left leg.

background.paragraph: Stock records from ordinary voyages list days of the week, quantities remaining in each crate and the meals shared by the crew. Folio
